description:
Resolve declared profile dependencies by `ProfileId` value instead of by string.

## Background

`resolve_dependency_package_from` takes `dependency: &str` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:1757-1762`) although its caller holds a `ProfileId` (`:1731`, `dependency.id.as_str()`). It compares `id.as_str() == dependency` (`:1767`) and `package.model().id.as_str() == dependency` (`:1778`), and rebuilds a selector from the string (`:1771`). The package graph keys packages by `ProfileId` (`profile/graph.rs:36-40`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `resolve_dependency_package_from` takes `&ProfileId` and compares `ProfileId` values.
- [hard] REQ-02: Profile dependency resolution and the package graph contain no string comparison of profile ids.
- [hard] REQ-03: Dependency resolution tests resolve the same packages as before.

## Notes

Applied-record comparisons and graph error payloads are left to the profile apply-once rework, which deletes or replaces that code.
title: Profile dependency resolution compares ProfileId values
